info.title: OpcUaAddressSpaceChecker
info.description: A .NET global tool that connects to an OPC UA server and validates its address space against NodeSet2 type models.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Checks an OPC UA server address space against NodeSet2 type models.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: OPC UA server endpoint URL (e.g., opc.tcp://localhost:4840)

options.name: --security-mode
options.description: Security mode: None, Sign, SignAndEncrypt [default: None]

options.name: --security-policy
options.description: Security policy: None, Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep, Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss [default: None]

options.name: --auth-mode
options.description: Authentication mode: Anonymous, UserName, Certificate [default: Anonymous]

options.name: --username
options.description: Username for UserName authentication

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for UserName authentication

options.name: --password-from-stdin
options.description: Read password from stdin (for piping) [default: False]

options.name: --certificate-path
options.description: Path to client X.509 certificate (PFX format)

options.name: --certificate-password
options.description: Password for the client certificate

options.name: --certificate-from-stdin
options.description: Read certificate (base64 PFX) from stdin [default: False]

options.name: --nodeset
options.description: Optional NodeSet2 XML file to load as a type-model override instead of the live server types. May be specified multiple times. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --nodeset-dir
options.description: Optional directory searched for companion NodeSet2 XML files when --nodeset is supplied. May be specified multiple times. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --config
options.description: Optional path to an appsettings.json config file (suppressed BrowsePaths and per-rule enable/severity). When omitted, appsettings.json is searched in the working directory and next to the tool; built-in defaults apply if none is found.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format: console, json, sarif, markdown [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional output file path. Console output writes to stdout when omitted.

options.name: --severity-threshold
options.description: Minimum severity included in results: information, warning, error [default: warning]

options.name: --rule-id
options.description: Rule ID to include. May be specified multiple times. Empty means all rules. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exclude-rule
options.description: Rule ID to exclude. May be specified multiple times. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --retry-count
options.description: Number of reconnection attempts on disconnect [default: 3]

options.name: --retry-delay
options.description: Delay between retries in seconds [default: 5]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging [default: False]

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Optional path to a log file. Parent directories are created on demand.
